contentTree.heading: Severability
contentTree.content:
The provisions of {{ref:500.000}} are severable. If a court of competent jurisdiction
declares any section, subsection, paragraph, or provision unconstitutional or invalid, the validity
of the remaining provisions shall not be affected.

REGULATORY AUTHORITY
{{ref:500.000}}: {{extref:M.G.L. c. 10, § 76}}, {{extref:M.G.L. c. 94G}}, {{extref:M.G.L. c. 94I}}, St. 2012, c. 369, St.
2016, c. 334, St. 2017, c. 55, and St. 2022, c. 180.
